# CLI reference

```text
A tmux-backed command center for running coding agents side by side.

Run `the-deaner` with no arguments to open the sidebar and terminal frame.

Usage: the-deaner [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

Commands:
  sidebar        Run the sidebar in the current terminal (the frame runs this for you)
  add            Add repos or folders to the sidebar
  new            Create a worktree for BRANCH in REPO and start a session for it
  open           Start (or unpark) a workspace and switch to it. A folder that isn't added yet is added first
  tab            Add a tab to a workspace, e.g. `the-deaner tab api claude` or `the-deaner tab api logs -- tail -f app.log`
  remove         Remove a worktree (deletes its folder) or a project (from the sidebar), stopping its tmux sessions
  ls             List workspaces, tabs and agent states
  send           Type a message into another agent's tab and press Enter
  whoami         Print this pane's address, for other agents to `the-deaner send` to
  peek           Show the end of a tab's output in a pager (`v` in the sidebar)
  save           Snapshot all workspaces now
  park           Save a workspace and stop its session; open it again to bring it back
  restore        Rebuild workspaces from the latest snapshot
  shutdown       Done for the day: save everything, then stop all sessions
  restart        Save everything, stop, and start again (picks up a newly installed version)
  upgrade        Install the newest release from GitHub (pacman or Homebrew), then restart into it
  install-hooks  Install the-deaner's status hooks into an agent's settings
  browse         Browse folders to pick a project, add it, and open it (`a` in the sidebar)
  cheatsheet     Open the searchable shortcut cheat sheet (Alt-/ inside the-deaner)
  guide          Read the docs here in the terminal: the guide (Tab in the cheat sheet), optionally at a page
  keys           Show keybindings
  config         Show where config and state live, or print the default config
  help           Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --shared
          Open alongside other windows instead of taking over (they stay attached and share the size)

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

  -V, --version
          Print version
```

## the-deaner remove

```text
Remove a worktree (deletes its folder) or a project (from the sidebar), stopping its tmux sessions

A worktree (`<repo>/<branch>`, see `the-deaner ls`): stops its session and deletes its folder with `git worktree remove`. Refuses when it has uncommitted changes, unless --force. Its branch stays unless --delete-branch, which deletes it only if it's merged (`git branch -d`).

A project: stops its sessions (its checkout and worktrees), drops a parked copy, and takes it out of the sidebar. Nothing on disk is touched; `the-deaner add` brings it back.

Usage: the-deaner remove [OPTIONS] <TARGET>

Arguments:
  <TARGET>
          

Options:
      --force
          Remove a worktree even with uncommitted changes (they're lost)

      --delete-branch
          Also delete a removed worktree's branch, if it's merged

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
```

## the-deaner restart

```text
Save everything, stop, and start again (picks up a newly installed version)

Asks about busy agents like `shutdown` does, saves a snapshot, and stops both tmux
servers. Every window that had the-deaner open starts it again by itself, from the
binary now on disk, and offers to restore your workspaces. Works from a the-deaner
tab or from any other terminal; with no window open, it starts in this terminal.

Usage: the-deaner restart [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --force
          Don't ask about agents that are still working

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
```

## the-deaner upgrade

```text
Install the newest release from GitHub (pacman or Homebrew), then restart into it

Asks GitHub for the latest release (through `gh`, or `curl` without a login). If it's
newer than this one, asks before installing it the way this copy was installed:

  pacman    downloads the package and its .sha256, checks it, runs `sudo pacman -U`
  Homebrew  runs `brew update`, then `brew upgrade the-deaner`
  cargo     prints the command to rebuild; nothing is installed

Once the new binary reports the new version, it restarts into it (see `restart`).
Nothing stops until then. The sidebar checks once a day and shows `↑ <version>` at
the bottom when there's something to install (`update_check` in config.toml).

Usage: the-deaner upgrade [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --check
          Only say whether there's a newer version; install nothing

  -y, --yes
          Don't ask before installing

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
```

## the-deaner install-hooks

```text
Install the-deaner's status hooks into an agent's settings

Usage: the-deaner install-hooks [OPTIONS] [AGENT]

Arguments:
  [AGENT]
          [default: claude]

Options:
      --uninstall
          Remove the-deaner's hooks instead

      --settings <SETTINGS>
          Settings file (default: ~/.claude/settings.json)

      --command <COMMAND>
          How hooks should invoke the-deaner
          
          [default: the-deaner]

  -h, --help
          Print help
```
